title: Advanced Markdown Viewer
description: Updates open Markdown previews when their file changes on disk.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Apply changes made to the file outside JupyterLab to the open preview, without a reload. Off, the preview changes only when you reload it; marks and notes still work.

animation.title: Animate changes
animation.description: Type added text in letter by letter and delete removed text from its end. Off, a change appears at once.

highlight.title: Highlight changes
highlight.description: Show added text on a green background and removed text on a red one.

author.title: Note handle
author.description: The handle written on your notes, without the @. Empty writes @user and asks for a handle at your first note.
